channel.title: PetSavings: Blog
channel.description: Practical pet advice for dog, cat and small pet owners: seasonal safety, reading food labels, new pet checklists and simple ways to save on pet costs.

item.title: Fireworks and pets: how to keep dogs and cats calm
item.description: How to prepare dogs, cats and small pets for fireworks season: safe dens, walk timing, noise, microchips and when to speak to your vet about anxiety.

item.title: How to read pet food labels
item.description: What dog and cat food labels really tell you: complete vs complementary, AAFCO statements, ingredient lists, “with chicken” naming rules and feeding guides.

item.title: New puppy checklist: what to buy and what to arrange
item.description: A complete new puppy checklist: the supplies to buy before day one, plus vet registration, vaccinations, microchip details, insurance and early training.

item.title: Winter and Christmas hazards for pets
item.description: The winter and holiday hazards most likely to harm pets: antifreeze, chocolate, grapes and raisins, xylitol, lilies, decorations and road salt, and what to do.
